rga_fa18_inb.description: Residual current-dependence correction for integrated epgamma Fa18 Inb when production acceptance uses only the 50 nA MC sample. Data fit: R_data(I) = b_d + m_d I with b_d = 0.0297518413 and m_d = -0.0000806542. MC fit: epsilon_mc(I) = b_m + m_m I with b_m = 0.0484711118 and m_m = -0.0000751975. The stored factor is epsilon_resid(I) = epsilon_data_rel(I) / epsilon_mc_rel(50 nA), where epsilon_data_rel(I) = R_data(I)/R_data(0) and epsilon_mc_rel(50 nA) = epsilon_mc(50 nA)/epsilon_mc(0) = 0.9224306012. cross_sections.cpp then applies 1 / epsilon_resid(I).
